title: Re-batch a stream, commit in order
prompt:
Write `Pipe(p Producer, c Consumer) error`. `p.Next()` returns small batches (≤ `MaxItems` items) with a cookie; `c.Process` wants big ones.

- Gather whole batches into a buffer of at most `MaxItems` (never split one) and hand it to `Process`.
- After `Process` succeeds, `Commit` that buffer's cookies in the order `Next` gave them.
- On `io.EOF`, flush the rest and return `nil`. Any other error: return it; never commit unprocessed cookies.
hint: Flush before appending a batch that wouldn't fit; allocate a fresh buffer after each flush, since `Process` may keep the slice.
